## Ceiling declaration + the honest projection (declared before the first metered call)

- **Delegated bound (dispatch):** ~$15 total (model+compute) under the
  standing ≤$50/day operator authorization plus "increase the budget if
  that is a constraint"; stop + report if the plan would exceed it.
- **Projection (committed records only):**
  - model — `fp_e_full` row of
    `docs/build/reports/2026-11-19-fp-e-comparative-quote.json`: n_trials
    150 (mini-swe-agent 50 + hh_native 50 + v5 50), **expected
    43,068,050 µ$ (~$43.07), ceiling 64,188,120 µ$ (~$64.19)**.
  - compute — `hh-compute-quote/1`
    `docs/build/reports/2026-11-19-fp-w4-quote.json`
    `pq-4f15fc7015dc1db1`: **ceiling 7,988,890 µ$ (~$7.99)** (D 22.5 h
    dead-man + 1 h restart + residual disk + egress estimate).
  - **total ≈ $51.06 expected / ≈ $72.18 ceiling-shape** — ~3.4× the
    delegated bound.
- **Disposition:** `stop_and_report` — the metered legs were not started
  under the delegated bound. The operator's "increase the budget if that
  is a constraint" covers the gap in principle; the delegated worker
  bound does not. Re-dispatch with a bound ≥ ~$72 (ceiling-safe) or
  ≥ ~$51 (expected) executes the declared window verbatim: PROV →
  verify → prepull → deliver-secret → lane probe → rounds 1–5 with the
  round-2 checkpoint → harvest → teardown + project deletion → upload →
  settlement, all under `fp-w4-r652.json`.

## Blocker (reported, not decided)

The ticket's arm execution needs a dispatch bound that covers the
committed plan (~$51 expected / ~$72 ceiling). Everything non-metered
the window needs is staged: project `ACTIVE`, declaration validated,
authorization pinned, records emitted. A re-dispatch can run the window
verbatim from `fp-w4-r652.json`.

**One engineering gap is named honestly:** the `w4-main` window driver
was never built — R6.47 fleshed `unused{scope_end}` under GATE-G30, so
the legs stay `skipped(executes-in-W4-under-R6.47)`-registered. The
runner/coordinator + per-slot drivers (`hh-w1 arm-run`/`h-run`,
proxy-session + corpus-driver pattern from Ws1) are committed, the
frozen held-10 set and `composed` k=5 coupled-pair schedule are pinned
in `2026-11-10-fp-prereg.json` (every drawn slot re-proofed by the Wc
windows — no `un_reproofed_successor` blocker remains), but the
schedule→slot orchestration script is new work the re-dispatch must
carry alongside the bound.
